description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin module, handling CRUD operations, history, logs, and related data for subscriptions.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription data, including CRUD operations, histories, logs, and related entities within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record and associated products, histories, and logs from the database.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining quantity of a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next date for a subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Deletes a subscription based on the customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record, decoding payment and shipping methods if present.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record associated with a specific order and product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscriptions based on various filters, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions matching filters.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions with a specific status.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches options for a specific subscription and product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes options for a subscription.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a status change or comment to the subscription history.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history records for a subscription.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history entries for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts history entries with a specific status.

methods.name: deleteLogs
methods.description: Deletes log entries for a subscription.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves log entries for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Counts total log entries for a subscription.
